_comment: Bounding box of the NotebookLM watermark, in pixels, for a 1920x1080 explainer. Measure it once from build/<unit>/frames/*.png (python src/postprocess.py --sample-frames) and fill these in. 'plate' paints an opaque rectangle before overlaying, needed only if our logo has transparency or the mark sits on moving background; set to null to overlay directly.
